Restricted access: the files of this record are restricted. You may request access to the files in this upload, provided that you fulfil the conditions below.
Supplementary File 4. The KHALIFAH Digital Literacy Analytic Framework (KDL-AF), Version 1.0

Coding manual, procedure, reliability standard, reporting checklist (KDL-R) and adaptation protocol. Supplement to: Prophetic AI and moral formation: A tawhidic framework for AI-mediated religious and moral education

What KDL-AF is.  KDL-AF is a framework for analysing  texts . It shows how far a text addresses the eight moral–epistemic dimensions of AI literacy that make up KHALIFAH Digital Literacy (KDL). The texts can be research studies, reviews, curricula, policies, competency frameworks or documentation of AI tools.
What KDL-AF is not.  KDL-AF is not a questionnaire or test for individuals, and it does not measure learners.
